name: MyFreeCams
summary: Veteran community-driven cam platform with loyal independent broadcasters, personal fan clubs (MFC Share), and a classic chat-first atmosphere.
ranking_rationale: Beloved by regulars for authentic independent models and tight-knit room chat, though its throwback UI and smaller scale show its age.

pricing.notes: Token bundles vary by package; check official checkout.

pros: High proportion of genuine independent broadcasters
Strong hangout and community chat culture inside rooms
MFC Share add-on lets models sell clip packs and fan clubs
cons: Dated 2000s interface and clunky mobile web experience
Smaller broadcaster volume than Chaturbate or Stripchat
Heavy focus on female solo rooms with limited other categories

facts.value: Public token-tipping rooms with private shows and MFC Share
Independent model community and MFC Share creator storefronts
